```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
# steinbock output (img/, masks/, intensities/, ...) and sample_metadata.xlsx;
# adjust if stored elsewhere
steinbock_dir <- here::here("..", "data")
```

```{r, include=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, cache=FALSE}
library(imcRtools)
library(cytomapper)
library(openxlsx)
library(stringr)
library(dittoSeq)
library(patchwork)
library(RColorBrewer)
```


```{r}
spe <- read_steinbock(steinbock_dir)
spe

```

```{r}
#counts
#counts(spe)[1:5,1:5]

#meta data cells
head(colData(spe))

#meta data channels
head(rowData(spe))

#spatial locations of cells
#head(spatialCoords(spe))

#colPair
#colPair(spe, "neighborhood")
```

# set colnames for each cell sampleId_ObjectNumber

```{r}
colnames(spe) <- paste0(spe$sample_id, "_", spe$ObjectNumber)
```

# add metadat

```{r}
meta <- read.xlsx(file.path(steinbock_dir, "sample_metadata.xlsx"))

spe$patient_id <- as.vector(sub("_001|_002|_003|_004|_005", "", spe$sample_id))
spe$ROI <- as.vector(gsub("^.*_(001|002|003|004|005)$", "\\1", spe$sample_id))
spe$indication <- meta$Indication[match(spe$patient_id, meta$Sample.ID)]

unique(spe$indication)
```

#Transform counts

```{r}
#counts transformation using an inverse hyperbolic sine function
assay(spe, "exprs") <- asinh(counts(spe)/1)

#scale exprs
assay(spe, "exprs_scaled") <- t(scale(t(assay(spe, "exprs"))))
```

#plot transformed results

```{r,fig.height=15}
p1 <- dittoRidgePlot(spe, var = "CD3", group.by = "patient_id", assay = "counts") + ggtitle("CD3 - before transformation")
p2 <- dittoRidgePlot(spe, var = "CD3", group.by = "patient_id", assay = "exprs") + ggtitle("CD3 - after transformation")
p3 <- dittoRidgePlot(spe, var = "CD3", group.by = "patient_id", assay = "exprs_scaled") + ggtitle("CD3 - scaled transformation")

(p1) / (p2) / (p3)
```

#Define interesting channels

```{r}
rowData(spe)$use_channel <- !grepl("DNA|ICSK", rownames(spe))
```


```{r}
unique(spe$sample_id)
```

#Define color schemes

```{r}
color_vectors <- list()

ROI <- setNames(brewer.pal(length(unique(spe$ROI)), name = "BrBG"), unique(spe$ROI))

patient_id <- setNames(c(brewer.pal(9, "YlOrRd"),
                         brewer.pal(9, "PuBu"),
                         brewer.pal(9, "YlGn"),
                         brewer.pal(7, "GnBu")),
                       unique(spe$patient_id))


sample_id <- setNames(c(brewer.pal(9, "GnBu"),
                        brewer.pal(9, "BuGn"),
                        brewer.pal(9, "YlGn"),
                        brewer.pal(9, "BuPu"),
                        brewer.pal(9, "PuBu"),
                        brewer.pal(9, "BuPu"),
                        brewer.pal(9, "PuBu"),
                        brewer.pal(8, "GnBu")),
                      unique(spe$sample_id))

indication <- setNames(brewer.pal(length(unique(spe$indication)), name = "Set2"), unique(spe$indication))

color_vectors$ROI <- ROI
color_vectors$patient_id <- patient_id
color_vectors$sample_id <- sample_id
color_vectors$indication <- indication

metadata(spe)$color_vectors <- color_vectors
```

#Read in images and masks

```{r}
#32-bit
images <- loadImages(file.path(steinbock_dir, "img"))

##all_mask <- scaleImages(all_mask,2^32-1)
#if16-bit (scale pixel set as.is = TRUE)
masks <- loadImages(file.path(steinbock_dir, "masks"), as.is = TRUE)

channelNames(images) <- rownames(spe)
images

#order of the images in both CytoImageList objects is the same
all.equal(names(images), names(masks))

#additional metadata to the elementMetadata slot of the CytoImageList

patient_id <- as.vector(sub("_001|_002|_003|_004|_005", "", names(images)))
indication <- meta$Indication[match(patient_id, meta$Sample.ID)] 
mcols(images) <- mcols(masks) <- DataFrame(sample_id = names(images),patient_id = patient_id,indication = indication)
```

#remove energy test RIOs
```{r}
spe <- spe[,!spe$sample_id %in% c("I1_003","I1_002","I1_001")]
```


#Save data in data folder of the workflow

```{r}
saveRDS(spe, here::here("data", "spe_all.rds"))
saveRDS(images, here::here("data", "images.rds"))
saveRDS(masks, here::here("data", "masks.rds"))
```
